groups.title: Work recorded as done
groups.why: A city record shows the work done after the request was filed (a mowing cut, a finished work order, a board-up or a completed demolition). Verify and close.

groups.title: Possibly superseded
groups.why: A later request of the same type at the same address is closed. Check whether it covered this one, then close.

groups.title: Administrative leftover
groups.why: Time-bound services long past (sirens, no water, mosquito spraying), more than 90 days past the date. Likely paperwork; close.
